purpose: Freeze code-domain raw-random, Stage-A-random, curated, and known-high-quality equal-token training arms for Qwen3-4B QLoRA continued-pretraining validation.
token_budget_rule: Use the largest common token-proxy cap that all materialized arms can satisfy, bounded by the curated and disjoint Stage-A-random pools. Raw-random and known-high-quality arms are independently sampled to that cap.
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
claim_boundary: Training-arm data freeze only; no target-model training result or Utility claim.
